verdict.rationale: LightSprint shows a Merge Readiness score that includes tests status, compile/typecheck, linting and a11y checks. It also runs GitHub Actions and has agents capture screenshots and video before review, which suggests changes are validated before they are proposed. Nothing in the evidence shows the agent writing new tests, and the test-running is only implied by a marketing readiness widget, not documented as an agent loop. Missing for 10: evidence the agent auto-generates tests, documentation of the agent running and iterating on tests before opening a PR, independent or hands-on corroboration.
